question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?

Placing the sponge on the counter surface using my right hand while holding the washed pot cover in my left hand so that i can rinse the pot cover.
Placing the sponge in the sink using my right hand while holding the slotted spoon in my left hand.
Using right hand, placing the sponge nearby the sink while using left hand picking up the frying pan from the sink.
Using my right hand to place the sponge on the counter surface while holding the tablespoon in my left hand so that i can rinse the tablespoon.
correct_answer: Using right hand, placing the sponge nearby the sink while using left hand picking up the frying pan from the sink.
